page.layout: One page of text, full width, with the running head "DE COENA DOMINI." and page number 46 at the top. Below the text, nothing printed. No margin notes.

main_text.p: scat & Christi Domini nostri Iesu Christi adversarij conficiantur. Rogaboq; ut amica aliqua collatione studeat potius om-nem nostram dissensionem componere: quam ut adversariorū nostrorum animos iam plus satis erga nos nostramque doctri-nam exacerbatos, suis scriptis amplius extimulet. Videt enim (si tamen hæc nostra scripta aliquando ad eius manus ventura sint)nos neque autoritatibus neq; rationibus destitui, quibus nostram sententiam fortiter tueamur. Velim præterea, ut hæc ipsa nostra scripta quibus tantum voluimus,nostrum in veritate investiganda ac proponenda studium declarare, candide atque benigne interpretetur:& Deum patrem Domini nostri Iesu Christi cómunibus nobiscum votis interpellet, ut omni dissensione sublata, &[?]veritas locum teneat,& Domini gloria in Ecclesia ab omnibus pijsunani-mi consensu celebretur,

page.notes: Line 1 begins with "scat", a fragment continuing from the previous page; the printed letter is a long s, rendered as s. The "&" before "veritas" on the line "fensione sublata" is followed by a mark I could not identify; it is marked [?]. The word "veritas" is followed by "&" and the printed sign looks like a backslash, not clearly readable. The paragraph is printed as one block, with the centred closing lines continuing it, and "AMEN." set apart as the closing word. Printed spelling is retained, including "Rogaboq;", "neq;", "voluimus,nostrum" and "pijsvnani-mi" (corrected to "pijsunani-mi" for u/v). Long s is shown as plain s throughout.
